verdict.rationale: Modal has an official, documented CLI reference (modal.com/docs/reference/cli). It covers running a command or interactive shell inside a Modal container and managing and connecting to running containers, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sandbox-specific CLI commands, evidence of agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
